program.name: No-Gear Week
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: No equipment, everything covered: bodyweight strength, a burst of cardio and a flow every day.
program.about: A balanced week with no equipment at all. One day is a bodyweight strength circuit, an AMRAP and a yoga flow; the other is supersets, a Tabata and a stretch. Strength, fitness and flexibility every session in about half an hour. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder versions of the strength moves.
program.split: Circuit, AMRAP & flow / supersets, Tabata & stretch
